passages.text: Our class notices that the small library door closes heavily behind people carrying books. Mia tells the caretaker right away instead of trying to repair the door herself. While an adult checks it, we guide visitors through the other entrance. The repair will make a difference to everyone using the room, especially those with full hands. Afterwards, the caretaker asks us to test the route with an empty box rather than heavy books. We report that the entrance feels easier to use and thank the people who helped solve the problem.

parallelText.en: Our class notices that the small library door closes heavily behind people carrying books.
parallelText.zh: 我们班发现，小图书室的门会在抱书的人身后重重关上。

parallelText.en: Mia tells the caretaker right away instead of trying to repair the door herself.
parallelText.zh: 米娅立即告诉管理员，没有自己动手修门。

parallelText.en: While an adult checks it, we guide visitors through the other entrance.
parallelText.zh: 成人检查时，我们引导访客走另一个入口。

parallelText.en: The repair will make a difference to everyone using the room, especially those with full hands.
parallelText.zh: 维修会影响每个使用房间的人，尤其是双手拿满东西的人。

parallelText.en: Afterwards, the caretaker asks us to test the route with an empty box rather than heavy books.
parallelText.zh: 之后，管理员请我们用空箱子代替重书测试路线。

parallelText.en: We report that the entrance feels easier to use and thank the people who helped solve the problem.
parallelText.zh: 我们反馈入口更好用了，并感谢帮助解决问题的人。

passages.text: Our class prepares a small stall at the school fair to sell handmade bookmarks. The bookmarks are on sale for two yuan each, and the money will buy new library cushions. Before opening, we tie a sign to the front rail so visitors can read the purpose clearly. Mia checks the knot while Ben makes sure that no loose string hangs across the walkway. A visitor asks whether the price is a special discount, and we explain that it is the regular fair price. Clear information and a tidy stall help people decide whether they want to support the project.

parallelText.en: Our class prepares a small stall at the school fair to sell handmade bookmarks.
parallelText.zh: 我们班在学校集市准备小摊，出售手工书签。

parallelText.en: The bookmarks are on sale for two yuan each, and the money will buy new library cushions.
parallelText.zh: 书签每张卖两元，所得会用来购买图书室新坐垫。

parallelText.en: Before opening, we tie a sign to the front rail so visitors can read the purpose clearly.
parallelText.zh: 开摊前，我们把标牌系在前栏，让访客看清用途。

parallelText.en: Mia checks the knot while Ben makes sure that no loose string hangs across the walkway.
parallelText.zh: 米娅检查绳结，本确认没有松绳横在通道上。

parallelText.en: A visitor asks whether the price is a special discount, and we explain that it is the regular fair price.
parallelText.zh: 一位访客问是否特价，我们说明这是集市的正常售价。

parallelText.en: Clear information and a tidy stall help people decide whether they want to support the project.
parallelText.zh: 清楚的信息和整洁的摊位，让人们便于决定是否支持这个项目。
